procedures.purpose: Audit opposed assertions while distinguishing a contradiction within one complete epistemic scope from a revision, changed world, or attributed disagreement.
orderedSteps: group structurally identical claims without reversing roles
classify equal-scope opposition as potential contradiction
retain differing-scope opposition as a revision or perspective pair
evidenceObligations: never merge possible with observed or attributed speech with narrator fact

procedures.purpose: Answer a pinned question or topic by selecting relevant evidence across the complete authorized source, tracking requested answer elements and avoiding redundant passages.

parameters.question: string
parameters.topic: string

orderedSteps: identify requested subquestions or answer elements
select direct and necessary contextual evidence
deduplicate repeated evidence while retaining all source locations
report coverage, gaps and unresolved elements

procedures.purpose: Produce explicitly provisional, passage-grounded literary observations across a complete work using supplied criteria, positive and negative anchors, and counterevidence.

criteria.name: Narrative coherence
criteria.description: How events and transitions form an intelligible narrative.

criteria.name: Characterization
criteria.description: How actions, speech and change establish characters.

criteria.name: Style
criteria.description: Observable language, imagery, voice and formal choices.
negativeAnchors: claim based only on generic praise

criteria.name: Thematic development
criteria.description: How a theme is introduced, varied and developed across the work.

orderedSteps: consider the entire selected work, not only opening passages
apply every supplied criterion and quote named textual anchors
record counterevidence or state where searched coverage is incomplete
mark judgments provisional and unresolved pending expert review
evidenceObligations: report complete-work coverage and uncovered regions
never label model interpretation as expert or human judgment
